title: Haul-Away of Replaced Appliances on Northgate Delivery & Installation Appointments
content:
Under Northgate Delivery & Installation, a member who asks, after booking, for the crew to take away the old appliances that an installation appointment replaces authorizes the removal personally, and it is booked as one haul-away entry dated the posting date with the appointment's currently booked delivery date as its service date. The old appliances removed are one for each appliance the appointment installs, the appliances installed being the kit units its installation parts kit entries carry, and the entry carries that number as its units.

The haul-away charge for the old appliances an installation replaces is fixed only once the appointment's installation parts kit entries cover every appliance it installs.

## Points of judgement

- **Who authorizes the removal?** The member, personally.
- **How many old appliances?** One for each appliance the appointment installs, counted as the kit units the appointment's installation parts kit entries carry.
- **How is it booked?** As one haul-away entry, dated the posting date, with the currently booked delivery date as its service date and the old appliances removed as its units.
- **When is the charge fixed?** Only once the appointment's installation parts kit entries cover every appliance it installs.

## Member authorization tool: `authorize_haul_away_734a64e4`

**What it does.** The member authorizes haul-away on their own installation appointment: the member asks the crew to take away old appliances on the delivery date and accepts the removal charge, which lands as one haul-away entry on the appointment. On success the appointment's fee history shows a new haul-away charge for the number of old items and the amount given, posted today and tied to the appointment date given, and the crew is booked to remove those old items on the delivery date.

**How it is invoked.** This is the member's own tool. The representative unlocks `authorize_haul_away_734a64e4` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | The member's own customer reference number, as read out to the member from the customer lookup by the representative | Identifier |
| `delivery_id` | The reference number of the member's installation appointment, as read out to the member from the delivery appointment lookup by the representative | Identifier |
| `service_date` | The appointment date the removal relates to | YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, no time or time zone; never empty |
| `old_items` | The billing units of the entry: the number of old items to be taken away | Whole positive integer |
| `amount` | The haul-away charge the member accepts, in USD | 2 decimal places, always positive; stored rounded to the cent |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a description of the authorized entry: `status` ("authorized"), `delivery_charge_id` (the new fee entry's reference number), `delivery_id` (the appointment charged), `charge_type` (always `haul_away`), `units` (the old items to be removed, an integer), `amount` (the charge in USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (the posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `service_date` (the appointment date the removal relates to, YYYY-MM-DD).
